classification: VERIFIED primary hardware reference; no flight telemetry
document: AGC Interface Specification, Block II, FR-2-130, changed 25 February 1966
verified_findings: THRSTD is generated while output channel 014 bit 4 is ONE
DINC reduces THRUST 0055 and emits signed output
Genuine ZOUT at zero clears the proper channel 014 bit and stops drive
scope: This document establishes the throttle-drive hardware handshake. Luminary099 and its source channel descriptions remain the authority for actual Apollo 11 software ON/OFF mappings.
